rel_select_sql: SELECT customers.customer_id, customers.first_name, customers.last_name, customer_orders.first_order, customer_orders.most_recent_order, customer_orders.number_of_orders, customer_payments.total_amount AS customer_lifetime_value FROM ((customers LEFT JOIN customer_orders USING (customer_id)) LEFT JOIN customer_payments USING (customer_id))
